dateline: Stanford, CA — Night 3 at Stanford Stadium concludes Bay Area residency; 'BTS: The City Arirang' Las Vegas opens tomorrow; all 7 members on Billboard Hot 100 simultaneously
heroHeadline: Day 4,723: BTS Completes Stanford Stadium Three-Night Residency — 150,000 Fans; Las Vegas Festival Opens Tomorrow
heroSubtitle: May 19, 2026 is Day 4,723 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS performs Night 3 at Stanford Stadium tonight (gates 4:30 PM, show 7 PM PT), concluding the sold-out three-night Bay Area residency that has drawn approximately 150,000 fans — the largest K-pop concert series in Northern California history. The Stanford Daily publishes a night-of review headlined 'ARIRANG: BTS electrifies Stanford Stadium in a long-awaited return.' On the charts, all seven BTS members simultaneously have solo songs charting on the Billboard Hot 100 for the first time — a historic full-group solo sweep. ARIRANG holds its eighth consecutive week in the Billboard 200 Top 5 and SWIM remains No. 1 on Billboard Global Excl. US. With Stanford complete, the ARIRANG World Tour advances to Las Vegas: 'BTS: The City Arirang' — the group's 11-day citywide festival — opens tomorrow (May 20), with the Las Vegas Sphere Exosphere, Strip landmarks, and all seven Monorail stations activating ARIRANG-themed visuals through May 31. Four Allegiant Stadium shows follow (May 23, 24, 27, 28). The FIFA World Cup Final halftime co-headlining with Madonna and Shakira at MetLife Stadium on July 19 remains confirmed.
